All 18 rules were searched across the full document and the plan is submitted.

Highlights for the reviewing team:

- **Located and substantive**: LOL-CAP (§9.7 plus §§5.2/6.2 liability provisions), INDEMN (§6.3 Servicer/Marketing Agent indemnities), T4C (§7.1 No Resignation, §7.2 Servicer Termination Events, §8.3), GOVLAW (§§10.5–10.7 New York/SDNY, with §11.2 dispute resolution), ASSIGN (§10.2 plus §§5.3 and 7.6 merger-succession twins), IP (§3.10 Custodian/Receivable Files, with the p0346 software carve-back), AUDIT (§§6.6–6.7 and Article XI — all running in our favour), WARRANTY (§3.2 servicing standard with §§2.5/2.6 and 3.3 reacquisition remedies), TRANSITION (§7.5 with §§7.3–7.4).
- **Likely absent / inapplicable**: MFN, NOSOLICIT, NONCOMPETE, EXCLUSIVITY, LICENSE, RENEWAL, MINCOMMIT, LD, INSURANCE. Of these, INSURANCE is the only one where a genuine gap (rather than structural inapplicability) is plausible.
- **Cross-rule caution flagged in the plans**: the p0346 carve-back (no obligation to license servicing processes, models or software to a Successor Servicer) touches IP, LICENSE and TRANSITION — workers should analyse it once, under TRANSITION or IP, and not flag it twice.
